Privacy

Last updated: 9 October 2026

couchpotato.ae is a price comparison site for furniture and home products sold by stores in the UAE. This page explains, in plain words, what we know about you when you use it.

If you just browse

We do not ask who you are. Your wishlist is kept in your own browser, on your own device.

Cookies and visit counting

We use Google Analytics to see how the site is used: which pages are opened, what people search for, and which store links are clicked. It only starts after you press Accept on the cookie notice. If you press Decline, nothing is sent. You can change your choice at any time with the “Cookie settings” link at the bottom of every page.

If you sign in with Google

  • Google tells us your name, your email address and your profile picture. We never see your Google password.
  • We keep your email and name so we know the account is yours, and we keep your wishlist so it follows you to your other devices.
  • Only you can see your wishlist. Other visitors, signed in or not, cannot.

Where it is kept

Accounts and wishlists are stored with our database provider, Supabase, on servers in India. Visit statistics are held by Google Analytics.

What we do not do

We do not sell your details, and we do not share them with the stores listed here or with advertisers.

Your choices

  • You can sign out at any time. Your wishlist is then removed from that device and stays in your account.
  • To delete your account and everything saved in it, email hello@couchpotato.ae from the address you signed in with. We will delete it within 30 days.

About the products shown

Product details, prices and photos are gathered from each store's public website and can change. Always confirm with the retailer before buying. When you click through to a store, that store's own privacy policy applies.

Questions

Email hello@couchpotato.ae.
